answers.answer: Shuffle all four III and place bottom; shuffle nine II and deal five face down above; shuffle three I and deal one on top, for 10 total. Return unused cards to box unseen.
answers.evidence: Setup 2: 1 I, 5 II, 4 III; unused returned without looking.

answers.answer: Four-player: 1 VP; three-player: 0 VP. Both: two Agents on Leader, third beside board; three troops in garrison, nine in supply; 1 water.
answers.evidence: Setup 6: score starts 1 in 4P, otherwise 0; Agents, troops and water listed.

answers.answer: You may Reveal with Agents left, but after Revealing your turns are skipped for the rest of Player Turns, so no later Agent turn that round. Reveal effects come only from remaining hand cards just revealed, not Agent-played cards. Clean Up sends all cards in front of you to discard.
answers.evidence: Player Turns and Reveal Turn: optional early Reveal, turns skipped, only revealed cards’ Reveal boxes, all cards to discard.

answers.answer: No: pay entry before resolving destination or played-card effects, so neither can pay that entry. One card sends one Agent, using one chosen icon. A card without Agent icons cannot be used for Agent placement; reveal it only.
answers.evidence: Agent Turn: costs immediately before effects; one card cannot send multiple Agents; iconless cards only revealed.

answers.answer: At Combat deploy the three recruited this turn plus at most two from garrison: five. At non-Combat deploy none by this rule. Recruited troops come from supply into garrison.
answers.evidence: Recruiting & Deploying: all recruited this turn plus up to 2 garrison; recruits come from supply.

answers.answer: Spy Agent icon allows access to a space connected to a post where your Spy is, without recalling it. Infiltrate recalls a Spy connected to an opponent-occupied destination to bypass that opponent. Gather Intelligence recalls a connected Spy to draw a card, chosen just after placement and before effects. One Spy cannot pay both; two can pay different effects.
answers.evidence: Spy rules: Spy Agent access without recall; Infiltrate/Gather Intelligence details and timing; cannot recall same Spy for both.

answers.answer: Strength is 11 (2×2 + 3 + 4×1). Removing your last unit makes strength 0. Combat Intrigue requires at least one unit in Conflict.
answers.evidence: Strength: troop 2, worm 3, sword 1; no unit means 0. Combat: at least one unit required.

answers.answer: Yes, a prior pass does not stop you acting again. Window closes after all involved players pass consecutively. After rewards, troops go to supply, markers reset to 0, worms return to bank.
answers.evidence: Combat: may act after pass; consecutive passes; cleanup destinations.

answers.answer: Two tied first each get second reward; nobody wins or takes card. In four-player, if exactly two tie first, remaining players compete for third; in three-player no other rewards. Zero strength gets nothing.
answers.evidence: Combat ties and resolution: tied first; player-count exceptions; 0 strength receives no reward.

answers.answer: Worm(s) double rewards once, not per worm; no quadrupling. Location control and battle icons on Conflict cards cannot double. For optional 3-spice/1-VP reward, may pay again: 3 spice=1 VP, 6=2 VP.
answers.evidence: Sandworm Reward Doubling: one or more doubles; exceptions; cost may be paid twice, example 3 or 6 spice.

answers.answer: When you win and take a Conflict, check against another face-up Conflict or Objective in your supply. Matching is mandatory: flip pair face down for 1 VP. At Endgame wild may match any of the three icons.
answers.evidence: Battle Icons section: eligible cards, must flip, wild Endgame match.

answers.answer: At 2 Influence gain 1 VP, lose below 2 and regain on reaching 2. At 4 get track bonus, retained below 4 and earned again upon return. First to 4 gets Alliance and its 1 VP, which follows holder. Tying holder does not steal; must go higher.
answers.evidence: Scoring/Faction Influence: 2 and 4 rewards, reversal distinctions, tie does not steal Alliance.

answers.answer: Spend during Reveal before/between/after effects; pool sources for one card or split one source across cards. Row refills to five and replacement is purchasable if affordable. Acquired card goes face up to discard. Unused Persuasion is lost.
answers.evidence: Acquiring Cards: timing, pooling/splitting, row replacement, destination, unused lost.

answers.answer: Agent-free Maker spaces add 1 spice each round; visitors take all bonus spice, including if choosing worms. Shield Wall blocks summoning at Arrakeen, Refinery, Basin. Hooks are required only when specified and are retained, not spent. Worms cannot enter garrison; deploy to Conflict, except protected conflicts while Wall remains.
answers.evidence: Makers and Sandworms: bonus spice, Wall protection, Hooks not universal/not spent, worms to Conflict never garrison.

answers.answer: Endgame triggers at end-of-round Recall if any player has 10+ VP or Conflict deck is empty. First may resolve Endgame Intrigues; then compare scores. Tiebreakers: spice, Solari, water, garrison troops.
answers.evidence: Recall and Scoring sections: trigger timing, Intrigues before winner, tiebreak order.

answers.answer: Shuffle 20 contracts; reveal two and put 18 face down in bank. Add four CHOAM Intrigues and four Imperium cards. Shaddam is optional. The ten contrasting-back Rise of Ix tokens are excluded from standard setup.
answers.evidence: CHOAM setup: contract counts, extra cards, optional Shaddam; contrasting-back tokens left in box.

answers.answer: Icon takes a face-up contract and replaces it face-up from bank; if none remain, gain 2 Solari. Harvest completes by visiting Maker space and gaining listed total spice that turn; Immediate completes on taking; Acquire TSMS completes when next acquiring it.
Cannot complete this turn; must have held contract when sending Agent, so wait for a future turn. On completion announce it, take shown rewards, flip face down and leave in supply.
answers.evidence: CHOAM: contract held at placement; completion announce, reward, flip and retain.

answers.answer: One shared scoring Rival. It gets Ornithopter; humans randomly get other two eligible objectives; the human whose Objective shows First Player takes marker. Order: First Player, Rival, other human. Rival never Reveals.

Occupied destination: ignore and reveal another. Place Spy does not place Agent: try specified empty post, ignore if none, then reveal another Hagal card and continue. Ignore normal space costs/effects, use Hagal effects only. Empty Hagal or Reshuffle: immediately reshuffle and continue.
answers.evidence: Rival Agent turns: occupied and Place Spy handling, costs/effects; empty/Reshuffle handling.

answers.answer: Remove mismatched player-count Objectives, shuffle eligible, each human draws one at random; marker on Objective sets First Player. Shaddam only with CHOAM.
Bank Solari/spice/water/worms are not limited; substitute when out. Empty personal troop supply prevents recruiting until troops return there. Resource payments go back to bank.
answers.evidence: Setup 7 and Recruiting & Deploying: substitution, troop limit, payments returned.

answers.answer: Round Start, Player Turns, Combat, Makers, Recall. Round Start reveals Conflict, resolves defensive troop, then draws five. If no Endgame at Recall, return Agents to Leaders, pass First Player clockwise, start next round.
Yes, resolve space effects, Agent-box effects and Faction advance in any order. Entry costs and requirements must be satisfied before effects, so this visit’s Influence cannot satisfy entry.
answers.evidence: Agent Turn: costs/requirements before effects; effects in any order.

answers.answer: No, optional arrow cost/effect is once per turn, except doubled Conflict reward. Most card/space effects mandatory; “may,” optional arrows and black-X trash are exceptions. Intrigue costs/conditions must be met.
answers.evidence: Arrows and FAQ Mandatory effects and costs.

answers.answer: Place from supply on an unoccupied observation post. If supply empty, may recall one Spy for no effect first. If effect specifies connected Agent-icon type, post must connect to that type.
answers.evidence: Spies & observation posts: open post, no-supply recall, specified icon requirement.

answers.answer: Cannot Infiltrate your own occupied space; it only bypasses another player. Spy recall does not replace playing an Agent-turn card. Cannot recall two Spies to Gather Intelligence twice on one placement, though one may Infiltrate and another Gather.

Controller gains bonus on any visit, even their own: 1 Solari at Arrakeen/Refinery, 1 spice at Basin. Winning relevant Conflict places/replaces control marker. When Conflict is revealed for already-controlled location, controller may deploy one troop from supply, no visit needed.

Tie second: each gets third reward; winner keeps their rewards/card; no other reward. Tie third: nothing. Three-way tie first: each gets second reward, no winner/card; in 4P with 3+ tied first, no further rewards.
Three distinct positive strengths in 3P: first and second get rewards; third none. This includes Rival as third player in two-human game.
answers.evidence: Combat resolution: 2 or 3 players including Rival; first/second rewarded, ordinary third nothing.

answers.answer: Plot on your Agent or Reveal turn; Combat during Combat; Endgame at game end. Keep face down separate from deck, reveal only when played, then face-up discard after resolve. If Intrigue deck empties, shuffle discard to new deck.
answers.evidence: Intrigue cards and FAQ Draw timing.

answers.answer: Ordinary discard is a chosen card from hand, not Intrigue unless specified. Secrets steals one at random from each opponent with 4+ Intrigues.
Trash can remove from hand, discard or in play. Return ordinary trashed cards to box; Reserve cards to Reserve stack. Optional unless cost or directed self-trash. TSMS acquire VP remains if trashed.
Acquire box resolves once at acquisition. When deck empty for a draw, reshuffle discard to form deck and continue. Unused Persuasion lost, cannot carry over.
answers.evidence: Acquire box, Acquiring Cards, Persuasion sections.

answers.answer: Agent-played and revealed cards are in play until Clean Up unless trashed. Fremen Bond can use one or more other Fremen cards in play; two Bond cards can activate each other irrespective of order. Clean Up ends in-play status.
Recall Agent returns one of your other board Agents, not the one sent this turn; it can act again on another Agent turn that round. Retreat sends troop to garrison. Retreat any number can mean zero.
answers.evidence: Recall Agent icon; Retreat; FAQ Combat and troops.

answers.answer: A free-choice gain of two Influence must all go to one Faction. Alliance icon requires holding that Faction’s Alliance; minimum-Influence effect requires stated minimum in named Faction.
If holder loses Influence while tied with multiple players, holder chooses which tied player receives Alliance. If holder falls to 3 or less and none at 4+, return Alliance to board; holder loses VP.

Draw during Reveal: immediately reveal/use that card this turn. Draw after Reveal: keep it for next round, then also draw five. Plot with later Reveal effect remains face-up until used, then discarded.
No, tying for first is not winning; cannot play “when you win” Intrigue. If received as reward for outright win, may play immediately.
If still tied after VP, spice, Solari, water and garrison troops, most recent Reveal turn wins. Score may exceed 12.
No; fulfill all held contracts for that space with one Agent placement. Contract effects are another Agent-turn effect and may resolve in any order with space/card effects.

Set-aside Sardaukar contracts do not start in Shaddam’s possession. When taking a contract, Sardaukar Commander lets him choose one instead of generally available contract. Signet deployment restriction starts immediately on Agent placement and lasts that turn, not round.
Feyd starts token at leftmost Training space; at rightmost it remains there. Lady Jessica side starts face-up. Reverend Mother Jessica may use ability on flip turn.
answers.evidence: Leader clarifications; FAQ Reverend Mother Jessica.

answers.answer: Moving 1 to 3 reaches 2; can reach 2 again after losing and regaining; descending through 2 does not count. Clean Up moving Spacing Guild’s Favor to discard does not trigger discard ability; discarding from hand does.
answers.evidence: Leader clarifications for Margot/Irulan and Guild’s Favor.

answers.answer: Accept Contract (Spice Trade): draw card; take contract with CHOAM, otherwise gain 2 Solari (also if none remain); no automatic Influence. Dutiful Service (Emperor): gain 1 Emperor Influence, then take contract with CHOAM or gain 2 Solari without/no contracts.
answers.evidence: Board Space Guide rows and note on explicitly listed Influence.

answers.answer: Arrakeen: City, no cost, Combat; recruit troop and draw card. Fremkit: Fremen, no cost, Combat; +1 Fremen Influence and draw. Research Station: City, 2 water, Combat; recruit 2, draw 2.

Deep Desert: 3 water, bonus spice plus choose 4 base spice or with Hooks summon 2 worms. Hagga: 1 water, bonus spice plus choose 2 base or with Hooks summon 1 worm. Bonus spice still collected with worms; Hooks retained.
answers.evidence: Board Space Guide and Sandworms rules.

answers.answer: Requires 2+ Fremen. Option 1: take Hooks if lacking, recruit one troop, gain 1 water. Option 2: gain 1 water and optionally remove Shield Wall; no troop.

High Council costs 5 Solari each visit, not Combat. First visit place Councilor on unoccupied seat and gain 2 Persuasion each Reveal for rest of game. Later visits gain 2 spice, draw Intrigue, recruit 3.
Swordmaster costs 8 Solari until anyone gets it, 6 thereafter; once per player. Gain third Agent, usable this round and rest of game. Rival acquisition also drops human cost to 6.
answers.evidence: Board Space Guide, Swordmaster; Rival note.

answers.answer: Imperial Privilege: Landsraad; requires 2+ Emperor; costs 3 Solari. May discard Intrigue to draw Intrigue; recall another Agent and draw a card. No automatic Emperor Influence.
answers.evidence: Board Space Guide Imperial Privilege; note on Influence.

answers.answer: Shipping: Spice Trade; 2+ Guild Influence; cost 3 spice; gain 5 Solari and 1 Influence with any Faction, not necessarily Guild.

Gather Support (Landsraad, noncombat): choose free or pay 2 Solari; recruit 2, and paid option also gives 1 water. Spice Refinery (City, Combat): choose free or pay 1 spice; gain 2 or 4 Solari; controller separately gets 1 Solari.

Heighliner: Guild, cost 5 spice, +1 Guild Influence, recruit 5; Combat. Desert Tactics: Fremen, 1 water, +1 Fremen Influence, recruit 1, optionally trash; Combat. Sardaukar: Emperor, 4 spice, +1 Emperor Influence, draw Intrigue, recruit 4; not Combat.

Assembly Hall (Landsraad, free): draw Intrigue; if Agent there during Reveal, gain 1 Persuasion. Espionage (Bene Gesserit, 1 spice): +1 Influence, draw card, place Spy. Deliver Supplies (Guild, free): +1 Guild Influence and 1 water. None are Combat.

False Orders makes affected opponents move Spy to empty post not connected to your Agent destination that turn; playable even without enemy Spy connected there. Litany red box ignored during Reveal or when gaining Agent icon and played as Agent.
Opponents cannot acquire Manipulated card. You can acquire it by other means but without 1-Persuasion discount. If not acquired by end of your next Reveal, remove from game.

Rival: four cubes at track bottoms; 3 troops garrison, remaining troops supply; two Agents supply, Swordmaster beside board; 3 Spies, 1 water; score and Combat marker 0. Shuffle Hagal retaining 2P Reshuffle. Rival 10 VP triggers Endgame at Recall and it may win.

When its total resources reaches printed threshold, spend that amount and take third Agent, usable this round. Count Solari, spice, Intrigue cards and water one each; spend Solari, then spice, then Intrigue, then water; keep leftovers.
Spend separate sets: 7 Solari, 7 spice, 3 Intrigues or 3 water each score 1 VP. Mixed seven does not qualify.
Choose least-Influence Faction, ties by leftmost priority. Rival gets 2-Influence VP and Alliance VP like human, but not 4-Influence resource bonus. Number points to position in Rival priority list.
No. Select destination by condition (Guild Influence for Accept/Shipping; Conflict tier for Deliver Supplies/Heighliner); if occupied reveal another card, do not use alternate destination.

Yes, at every Combat space deploy up to two available garrison troops even if none recruited. Recruitment at noncombat goes to garrison. Unmet conditional 2+ Influence bonus is skipped and does not block placement.

Without post type, first available Faction post in priority; if all four occupied ignore placement. Placing third/final supply Spy recalls its other two and triggers Scheme. Rival cannot Infiltrate or Gather Intelligence.
If Scheme recruits before placement and Rival then visits Combat, those recruits deploy too. Place Spy with no legal post is ignored, then reveal another Hagal card because no Agent was placed.

Rival takes all bonus spice. With Hooks and worm-legal Conflict, Hagga summons 1 and Deep Desert 2 instead of base spice. No Hooks/protected space: no worms, take base (2 Hagga, 4 Deep). Hooks retained.
answers.evidence: Rival Maker spaces and Maker Hooks.

answers.answer: At Combat start, only if it has a unit deployed, reveal Hagal card and add bottom swords; Reshuffle means shuffle and reveal again. Humans then have Combat Intrigue window. Unit-free Rival gets no bonus.

Yes to control, defensive troops, battle-icon VP and doubled rewards normally. Always take optional Conflict VP if able to pay or recall required Spies. Under CHOAM it never takes contracts; contract reward is 2 Solari.
During Reveal effects total/announce and set strength at any point, updating as needed. Over 20 flip marker to +20 side and start track again.
Signet Ring Leader ability activates when played on Agent turn; merely revealing it does not activate. Card text can override usual rules.
Recall Spy icon returns one Spy from post to supply, usually as cost. It is distinct from no-card Infiltrate/Gather Intelligence and does not automatically do either.
Trash-an-Intrigue icon trashes one Intrigue of choice from hand. Ordinary discard instruction is a chosen hand card and excludes Intrigue unless specified.
Yes: a sandworm-doubled reward of “gain 1 Influence” can give its two instances to same or different Factions. A single effect granting 2 free-choice Influence must put both in one Faction.
answers.evidence: Sandworm doubled reward example; Influence rule.

answers.answer: Resolve the Rival card’s printed Signet Ring ability. No human Signet Ring card or Reveal turn is needed.
answers.evidence: Rival follows printed Signet Ring/Scheme; never Reveals.

answers.answer: Maker Hooks icon takes a token only if Rival lacks one. Shield Wall removal works only if Rival has Hooks and Wall remains; otherwise ignored.
Secrets: Bene Gesserit, free, non-Combat; +1 BG Influence and draw Intrigue from deck; each opponent holding 4+ gives one randomly selected Intrigue.
Imperial Basin: Spice Trade, free, Combat. Visitor gets 1 base plus all accumulated bonus spice; controller gains 1 spice separately, including when same player.
answers.evidence: Board Space Guide Imperial Basin and controller note.

answers.answer: Place new Conflict face up next to deck atop any unclaimed earlier Conflict; resolve defense bonus, then draw five cards.
Four human cubes start on bottom spaces of Faction tracks; Alliance tokens on marked track areas, so no player starts holding one. Shield Wall starts on board below Refinery.

First Player starts; clockwise turn order, skip those Revealed; 3–4P Player Turns ends when all have Revealed. Combat Intrigue starts with First Player clockwise; eligible player may play any number before passing.
Reveal all remaining hand; resolve their Reveal effects; Clean Up all cards to discard. Effects may be chosen in any order.

Shuffle each 10-card starter deck face down. Shuffle Intrigue and Imperium separately; deal 5 Imperium face-up Row; Reserve stacks Prepare the Way and TSMS separate. Combat marker at 0; three Spies, Councilor and Control markers in supply.
Ordinary purchases: any of five Imperium Row cards, Prepare the Way or TSMS; cost at top-right; purchase during Reveal.
Spy placement and Recall are optional even with legal choice. Shield Wall destruction is optional; once removed to box it cannot return.

Ordinary card must match destination icon; connected Spy alone does not give City-only card Shipping access. A Spy Agent icon on card permits connected-space access while Spy is there, without recalling it.
Yes, Plot Intrigue may first grant resources before placement and those can pay entry. Card Agent-box or destination rewards after placement cannot pay that same cost.
answers.evidence: Plot timing and Agent cost rule.

answers.answer: No. After both humans Reveal, continue Rival Agent turns while it has Agents; Combat starts only after Rival used all. Rival never Reveals.

answers.answer: On reveal of a Conflict for a location already controlled, controller may deploy troop from supply directly to Conflict, no visit needed. Optional. After rewards all Combat markers reset to 0 before Makers.

Play one card from hand face up; send Agent from Leader to matching unoccupied space; resolve Agent box, not Reveal box. Cannot reuse card from in-play/discard or simply move a board Agent as the turn’s Agent.
Restriction begins immediately upon playing Signet Ring to place Agent; ordering space effects first cannot postpone it.
In 4P with distinct positive strengths: first, second, third rewards; fourth none. Highest-strength player wins/takes Conflict card.
Players may choose Leaders or select randomly.
Draw from your own deck; if empty shuffle discard into new deck. Cannot choose directly from discard.
